arguments.content:
from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import uuid

# "Next Wednesday" = Wednesday of the next ISO week (the week after the current one)
today = date.today()
this_monday = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())
next_wednesday = this_monday + timedelta(days=9)  # next Monday + 2 days

# Use the system's local timezone so the 3 PM start reflects the user's local time
local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
tz_name = getattr(local_tz, "key", None) or str(local_tz)
try:
    tz = ZoneInfo(tz_name)
except Exception:
    tz = ZoneInfo("UTC")
    tz_name = "UTC"

dtstart = datetime(next_wednesday.year, next_wednesday.month, next_wednesday.day, 15, 0, tzinfo=tz)
dtend = dtstart + timedelta(hours=1)

cal = Calendar()
cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN")
cal.add("version", "2.0")

event = Event()
event.add("summary", "Team Meeting")
event.add("dtstart", dtstart)
event.add("dtend", dtend)
event.add("dtstamp", datetime.now(ZoneInfo("UTC")))
event.add("uid", f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendarskill")
event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
event.add("sequence", 0)

# 15-minute reminder before the meeting
alarm = Alarm()
alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
alarm.add("description", "Team meeting starting soon!")
alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
event.add_component(alarm)

cal.add_component(event)

with open("team_meeting.ics", "wb") as f:
    f.write(cal.to_ical())

print("Created team_meeting.ics")
print(f"Meeting date: {next_wednesday.isoformat()} ({next_wednesday.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Start: {dtstart.isoformat()}")
print(f"End:   {dtend.isoformat()}")
print(f"Timezone: {tz_name}")

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, date
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import uuid

# "Next Wednesday" = Wednesday of the next ISO week (the week after the current one)
today = date.today()
this_monday = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())
next_wednesday = this_monday + timedelta(days=9)  # next Monday + 2 days

# Use the system's local timezone so the 3 PM start reflects the user's local time
local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
tz_name = getattr(local_tz, "key", None) or str(local_tz)
try:
    tz = ZoneInfo(tz_name)

    tz = ZoneInfo("UTC")
    tz_name = "UTC"

dtstart = datetime(next_wednesday.year, next_wednesday.month, next_wednesday.day, 15, 0, tzinfo=tz)
dtend = dtstart + timedelta(hours=1)
dtstamp = datetime.now(ZoneInfo("UTC"))
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendarskill"


def fmt_local(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")


def fmt_utc(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",

    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",

    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting starting soon!",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\r\n") as f:
    f.write("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n")

print("Created team_meeting.ics")
